category_title: Students exhibiting aggressive behaviors and elopement during non-preferred academic tasks
scenario_title: Math counting assignment with nonpreferred worksheet
minimal_context: Ann is sitting in the classroom and is asked to count objects on a math worksheet and then color them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ann, it is time for math. Please count the objects on this worksheet and then color them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the paper and does not start counting, failing to comply with the instruction within 5 seconds.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, you need to finish your math assignment. Let's get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! (Stands up, leaving contact with her designated chair for more than 3 seconds.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down in your chair and look at your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the crayons at the tutor, rips the worksheet, and starts running out of the classroom without permission.)
